intro: Publishes this database's port ({{port}}) on the server, so tools outside this server and services in other projects can reach it. Saving only stores the port: redeploying is what opens it, and it restarts the database. Services in this project don't need this.

warning.title: Think twice before exposing a database
warning.description: Anyone who can reach this port can try to connect, and bots look for open databases. Keep a strong password, and limit access with a firewall if you can.

hint: Use 0 to stop exposing it, or a free port from 1024 to 65535.
invalid: Use 0, or a whole number from 1024 to 65535.

confirm.title: Expose this database?
confirm.description: Port {{port}} will be reachable from outside this server. Keep a strong password.

savedHint: Redeploy the database to apply it.
notPublishedYet: Port {{port}} is saved but not published yet. Redeploy the database to open it.
